knowledge: The task requirements list `src/metabase/api/alert.clj` as a file to create/modify, but this path does not exist and there is no `metabase.api.alert` namespace in the repository. The real alert API endpoint implementation is in `src/metabase/pulse/api/alert.clj` (namespace `^:deprecated metabase.pulse.api.alert`). Its existing test namespace is `metabase.pulse.api.alert-test` located at `test/metabase/pulse/api/alert_test.clj`. Any new test file for Malli schema validation of these endpoints should follow this same `test/metabase/pulse/api/` directory and `metabase.pulse.api.*` namespace pattern rather than the non-existent `metabase.api.alert` path.
